Messages.Author: a-e
Messages.Body:
> mirddes wrote:
> which untap cards does the sleeping mind work against?
>
> which untap cards does it not work against?
>
At superior it prevents minions to untap during action, so reactions like Second Tradition, Black Sunrise or Eluding the Arms of Morpheus can't be played. It also prevents you to untap with Freak Drive or Forced March. Or if the action is blocked or action itself results a combat, superior Majesty or Earth Meld can't be played to untap in combat. Reactions that allow to block or play cards as untapped can be played, as those don't untap the reacting minion.

Marko, Prince of Helsinki

It doesn't just negate the effect. Superior Sleeping Mind forbids you to play inferior Meld with the Land, because minions cannot untap during the action. So if superior Sleeping Mind is played on action, no card or effect can be played at all that would untap any minion during that action.

Marko, Prince of Helsinki

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
I don't know what your cards read, all I know is that the only valid cardtext for Sleeping Mind is:
Name: The Sleeping Mind
[Sabbat:C, SW:C, Third:PTr]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Dominate
Only usable when the action is announced.
[dom] Choose a tapped vampire. He or she cannot attempt to block this action.
[DOM] Minions cannot untap during this action.
Artist: Greg Simanson

(found here: vekn.net/images/stories/downloads/cardlist.txt )

If the question is "I bleed with The Sleeping Mind, can they Wake with Evening's Freshness + Deflection?", the answer is yes (none of the cards played in that sequence untaps a vampire).

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> dabbler wrote:
> so does anyone know why mine is texted as it is?
>
Card text on printed cards was often changed between versions. Sometimes, they were just minor standardizations. Other times, cards had been errata-ed for power and balance concerns, and the next time they were reprinted they got the updated text.

Compare, for example, the card image in vtes.pl/card/40227 with the card image in vtes.pl/card/63833

The 'right' card text is always whatever's most recent (either in terms of printed cards, or more recent errata). You don't, for example, get to play Aire of Elation after playing Conditioning, just because you happen to own a  Jyhad Conditioning - the Jyhad Dominate bleed modifiers name-checked the three available modifiers, rather than the current text.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Also, if you've only been playing with Jyhad cards, do notice that Majesty "now" costs 1 blood at all levels.
